set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== create backup dir =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/backups/inventory
sudo -n chown antrieb:antrieb /var/backups/inventory
sudo -n chmod 750 /var/backups/inventory

echo "== write backup script =="
sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.sh > /dev/null <<'SCRIPT_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

SRC_HOST="node2"
SRC_USER="antrieb"
SRC_PATH="/srv/inventory/data"
DEST_DIR="/var/backups/inventory"
RETAIN_COUNT=7
DATE_STAMP="$(date -u +%F)"
ARCHIVE="$DEST_DIR/inventory-data-$DATE_STAMP.tar.gz"
TMP_ARCHIVE="$ARCHIVE.partial"

mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"

ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no "$SRC_USER@$SRC_HOST" \
  "tar -C \"$(dirname "$SRC_PATH")\" -czf - \"$(basename "$SRC_PATH")\"" \
  > "$TMP_ARCHIVE"

mv "$TMP_ARCHIVE" "$ARCHIVE"

# Retain only the most recent RETAIN_COUNT dated archives.
ls -1t "$DEST_DIR"/inventory-data-*.tar.gz 2>/dev/null \
  | awk -v keep="$RETAIN_COUNT" 'NR>keep' \
  | xargs -r rm -f --

echo "backup complete: $ARCHIVE"
SCRIPT_EOF
sudo -n chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.sh
sudo -n chown root:root /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.sh

echo "== install nightly cron (02:00) =="
sudo -n tee /etc/cron.d/inventory-backup > /dev/null <<'CRON_EOF'
0 2 * * * antrieb /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.sh >> /var/log/inventory-backup.log 2>&1
CRON_EOF
sudo -n chmod 644 /etc/cron.d/inventory-backup

sudo -n touch /var/log/inventory-backup.log
sudo -n chown antrieb:antrieb /var/log/inventory-backup.log

echo "== ensure crond running =="
sudo -n systemctl enable --now crond
systemctl is-active crond

echo "== verify files =="
cat /etc/cron.d/inventory-backup
ls -la /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.sh
